max_plan_file_bytes.description: Max bytes for a single plan file (default: 140KB, min: 10KB, max: 512KB)

smith_max_review_rounds.description: Ceiling on Smith review rounds in Oracle high-accuracy mode. Burn control only — the loop normally exits earlier on convergence (default: 8, min: 2, max: 20)

scope.description: Task storage scope: project → .matrixx/tasks per project (default), global → <opencode-config>/tasks/{listId}

stale_after_hours.description: Pending tasks with no file activity for this many hours are considered stale and excluded from task-continuation directives. Accepts fractional hours (minimum 0.25 = 15 minutes); there is no separate minutes companion key. Default 24.

background_stale_after_hours.description: Window used only by the completion gates: a pending/in_progress task with no file activity for this many hours stops blocking completion of its background handle. Separate from stale_after_hours because a missed nudge and a wedged handle are different failures. Accepts fractional hours (min 0.25). Default 2.

session_scoped.description: When true, the task-continuation-enforcer only considers tasks created by the current session (or its subagent sessions). When false, all project tasks are considered regardless of session origin.
